summary.text: Edge of Eternities takes place at the edge of a connected star system around Sothera, a star the Monoists have killed into a supervoid, where the Palatinate's Sunstar Free Company knights hunt them aboard the Dawnsire.

The story follows the Monoist Alpharael, who throws away his sekhar bead in the battle and sends a microvoid through Syr Vondam's head, and Vondam's squire Haliya, as well as Sami and the Kav Tannuk, whose search for Sigma's Reach turns up an odd, lucky stone.

The stakes grow when Vondam believes the object is calling for a wielder and invokes protocol seven, which demands the destruction of everything it touches, and Haliya must decide whether to obey while the Sundog burns Taro-duend.
